scope: Independent saved-record recomputation and source/binary verification only. No engine/evaluator execution, build or new timing. Sole write: this final JSON. Prior 87943a6 audit unchanged.

source_identity.method: Raw source hashes matched current files; CRLF normalized to LF for exact comparison against frozen Git blobs. Added v056 reference files retain LF. Frozen v056 source differs from baseline only in include/function name.
source_identity.limits: Observed identities and declared compile provenance are verified; this is not a reproducible-build or cryptographic source-to-executable proof.

micro_profile.ratio_definition: Median of nine block ratios candidate ns/call divided by baseline ns/call, less than one favors candidate. Board construction, equivalence and IO untimed; identical calls/order and separate translation units/no LTO maintained.

fixed_depth.ratio_definition: new/old is candidate elapsed divided by baseline elapsed; below one is faster candidate. old/new speedup above one is faster candidate. Each median recomputed directly.
fixed_depth.limits: Wall includes UCI transaction and new-game reset, startup excluded. Engine milliseconds can be zero/quantized; zero samples excluded from engine-time ratios. Fixed-depth selected positions, not equal-time playing-strength tests.

correctness.counts_note: Child unit suites counted once; GUI checks separate from native C++ assertion totals.

nonfatal_log_observations.event: ConnectionAbortedError WinError10053 while test HTTP server wrote a response
nonfatal_log_observations.result: Nonfatal: synthetic38/live35 report zero failures and final lifecycle pass.
nonfatal_log_observations.interpretation: Consistent with delayed-response cancellation being exercised; inferred from test context, not reproduced. The log is not completely clean. Some local error-message bytes were decoded with UTF-8 replacement for this audit.

desktop_boundary.limits: Boundary cumulative CPU only for matching known desktop engines; excludes replaced/exited processes. Aggregate monitor has separate sampling limitations.

limits: Only processes readable at both sample endpoints counted; new, exited, replaced and inaccessible processes may be omitted.
Search target is a wrapper; regicide group includes benchmark engines. Remaining CPU includes unclassified benchmark children such as Python, not exact external interference.
Browser counts overlap aggregate. Host percentages use 16 logical CPUs; one saturated logical CPU is 6.25 percent host capacity.
Zero matching desktop processes at boundaries does not prove continuous absence and excludes exited/replaced processes. No thermal, clock, affinity or idle-host guarantee.

first_shared_loop.decision: Rejected before deployment: exact scores but standalone evaluation slower

second_compact_table.decision: Evaluate a further unchanged-score candidate: component faster, whole search improvement not demonstrated; not deployed

earlier_candidates.interpretation: First pilot was slower and rejected. Second improved evaluator-only cost but did not demonstrate whole-search gain; neither was deployed. Final signed-square candidate is distinct and prior original measurements remain saved.

conclusions.score_and_search_preservation: All 220 pairs strictly match the seven recorded graph fields, with legal PVs and TT totals/reuse independently validated. Extensive frozen/scalar/rule tests pass; this is sampled evidence, not a formal proof for every legal position.
conclusions.evaluator_cost: new/old cost 0.804254 with shield ON and 0.803462 with shield OFF: about 19.57 and 19.65 percent lower on 58 predeclared positions.
conclusions.whole_search_cost: new/old wall medians 0.977919/0.982888/0.973126 at default depths3/4/5: about 2.21/1.71/2.69 percent lower. Other flag modes are about 1.35 to 1.44 percent lower. Modest, condition-specific sampled gains do not guarantee universal speedup.
conclusions.strength: No Elo, win-rate or playing-strength gain measured; scores/search behavior are intentionally preserved.
conclusions.load: Nonzero browser/other observed CPU load remained; do not claim idle or CPU-isolated host.
